evidence_timeline.summary: We report the spectroscopic follow-up of the young Type II SN2026cff with the EFOSC2 spectrograph at the ESO NTT telescopes. Spectra were obtained during the nights of 2026 Feb. 08, 09 and 10. Observations were conducted in the context of the ESO La Silla Observing School 2026.
evidence_timeline.title: NTT/EFOSC2 spectroscopic follow-up of the young Type II SN2026cff

evidence_timeline.summary: We report optical spectroscopic classifications of SN2026cff as a young Type II SN in NGC 3660 (59.78 Mpc), probably within a few days after explosion. The spectrum shows a blue continuum with a few emission features, including Halpha. Observations were taken with the EFOSC2 spectrograph at the NTT during the night of 2026 Feb. 07 UT. Observations were conducted in the context of the ESO La Silla Observing School 2026.
evidence_timeline.title: NTT/EFOSC2 spectroscopic classification of SN2026cff as a young Type II SN in NGC 3660
